recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the current build should harmonize fhir.ini [fmm] and StructureDefinition FMM values for Library and the parallel CDS/CQI resources, handle that as a separate maturity-policy review rather than as a replay of FHIR-30800.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive CDS change request raised against R4 and applied for R5 asking to update the Library resource maturity level to 3.
initial_application: Commit a1b81e4b8c0b0f5be274889ea177c22b014c320f explicitly applied J#30800 by changing source/library/structuredefinition-Library.xml from structuredefinition-fmm 2 to 3 and source/fhir.ini [fmm] library from 2 to 3.
additional_context: Library is active in source/fhir.ini and owned by CDS. A later non-Jira-tagged 2023 commit, 70c0de23a78f8c63504d6250fc05889c33f04fbb, proposed higher fhir.ini [fmm] levels for several CDS/CQI resources and raised Library there to 4, while Library and neighboring CDS/CQI StructureDefinition extensions remained at 3. The CDS 2021-02-03 Confluence agenda lists FHIR-30800 with related maturity trackers and records that those trackers were approved in Jira; no conflicting Zulip or Confluence item was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reverting or editing later fhir.ini maturity metadata under this seed would overreach beyond FHIR-30800 because the source location directly changed for the issue still reflects FMM 3.
